messages:
Marie: Quick sync — thinking through Console UX for automatic fallback forensic traces. What should we surface when a request auto-degrades? what do we keep and what do we block?

Devon: Agree we need visibility. Minimum: request_id, decision_reason (error/latency/kv-miss), selected_fallback_model, timestamps. :+1:

Alex: Also include a small, redacted sample of inputs for debugging: prompt_hash, length, first_token, last_token. No raw prompt by default.

Jordan: Two UX tiers Id push for: forensic (full trace for ops, exportable) and summary (counters + rates). Which is default? :thinking_face:

Marie: Summary as default. Forensic behind a toggle + RBAC + sampling. No prompt text in default view.

sre-bot: incident:autofallback created request_id=r-62b8 rule="latency>500ms" action=soft_degrade fallback_model=redwood-small-q4

Devon: Need sampling config (default 0.1) and a dry-run mode so teams can preview how many requests would have triggered without switching models.

Alex: Privacy snippet proposal: \n```\nfallback_policy:\n  condition: "latency_ms > 500 or error_rate > 0.03"\n  mode: soft_degrade  # soft_degrade | hard_degrade | cached_response\n  fallback: redwood-small-q4\n  forensic_audit: true\n  forensic_sample: 0.05\n  redact_level: prompt_hash_only\n```\n
Jordan: Console idea: route timeline showing total_requests, fallback_rate, median_latency, top_reasons. Click a window to open forensic traces (if allowed). Add an inline "replay" that runs a safe sandboxed simulation (no external calls).

Marie: Forensic panel fields: minimal event stream with [ts] decision, [ts] model-start, [ts] model-fallback, latency bands, optional stacktrace. Export as .ndjson with metadata only; raw prompt opt-in.

Devon: Telemetry contract: request_id, route, env, decision_code, fallback_model, latency_ms, cache_hit, sampled_forensic (true/false), trace_id. Keep stable names.

Alex: API debate: return header `X-Redwood-Fallback: soft_degrade;model=redwood-small-q4` so apps can adapt. Id add a feature flag to opt-out.

Jordan: Degrade mode semantics: silent_degrade = no explicit status (return best-effort), explicit_degrade = return 503 + body explaining fallback. Need clear docs so customers know behavior.

Marie: Console should allow per-route default mode + override per-policy. Also show a dry-run timeline to preview impact for PMs.

deploy-bot: policy apply start: canary=eng-canary cluster=dev -> 2/3 hosts updated

Devon: Retention: forensic traces default 7d, extended to 90d for paid/compliance. Configurable per-org.

Alex: Security: encrypt forensic blobs at rest, key rotation, and provide expunge/delete APIs for DSARs.

Marie: Action items:
- Devon: draft telemetry schema + sampling config PR
- Alex: propose header contract + privacy/redact options
- Jordan: wireframe forensic panel + dry-run timeline
- Svox: validate retention/export S3 flow
I'll open a tracking ticket and link the designs. Thanks all :raised_hands:
